SIBAWAYH:(هذابابأوفيغيرالاستفهام)#518/r3.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابأوفيغيرالاستفهام)#518/r3.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابأوفيغيرالاستفهام)#518/r3.claim: In ولا تطع منه آثما أو كفورا, أو means that neither a sinner nor an ingrate is to be obeyed.

BURSEVI:v10p213#3/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p213#3/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p213#3/r1.claim: The command not to obey a sinner or disbeliever warns the Prophet against Meccan pressure, including offers to stop preaching; even an innocent Prophet’s example shows people need repeated guidance against heedlessness and desire.
BURSEVI:v10p213#3/r1.anchor: وفي نهيه عليه السلام عن الإطاعة فيما يدعونه إليه مع إنه ما كان يطيع أحدا منهم ولا يتصور في حقه ذلك إشارة إلى أن الناس محتاجون

BURSEVI:v10p213#3/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p213#3/r2.speaker: القاشاني
BURSEVI:v10p213#3/r2.claim: Al-Qashani reads the sinner as one veiled by attributes or self from the Divine, and the disbeliever as one veiled by actions and their effects; agreement with them would veil the seeker too.
BURSEVI:v10p213#3/r2.anchor: ولا تطع منهم آثما أي محتجبا بالصفات والأحوال

QASHANI:76:23-25/r2.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:76:23-25/r2.speaker: author
QASHANI:76:23-25/r2.claim: Patience for the decree is endurance of the self-disclosure of divine unity in annihilation amid the trial of ego’s remaining; at the descent of attributes, Lord is the Essence alone.
QASHANI:76:23-25/r2.anchor: التجلي الأحدي الذاتي في مقام الفناء مع بلاء ظهور الأنائية والبقية

QASHANI:76:23-25/r3.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:76:23-25/r3.speaker: author
QASHANI:76:23-25/r3.claim: Do not obey sinners veiled by qualities and states or disbelievers veiled by acts and effects, since following them perpetuates those veils.
QASHANI:76:23-25/r3.anchor: محتجبا بالأفعال والآثار واقفا معها بأفعاله ومكسوباته عن الأفعال

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p87/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p87/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p87/r1.claim: The Prophet should persevere despite opponents, trust God, and seek patience through prayer and remembrance.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p87/r1.anchor: He will help him in every difficulty.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p87/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p87/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p87/r2.claim: Disbelievers' real ailment is unwillingness to sacrifice immediate gains for the Hereafter; they fabricate objections despite its certainty, though recreating them is easy for God.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p87/r2.anchor: The real ailment of the disbelievers is that they do not have the courage to sacrifice the immediate gains of this world

QUSHAYRI:v3p377/r13.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p377/r13.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p377/r13.claim: Patience with God's decree means accepting and submitting to it; the Prophet must obey his Lord alone, not a sinner or unbeliever.
QUSHAYRI:v3p377/r13.anchor: وهذا أمر له بإفراد ربه بطاعته

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p357/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p357/r4.speaker: الحسن وعكرمة
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p357/r4.claim: Hasan and ʿIkrima exempt the command ‘do not obey among them a sinner or unbeliever’ as Meccan.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p357/r4.anchor: مدنية إلا آية واحدة فإنها مكية وهي: ولا تطع منهم آثما أو كفورا

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p357/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p357/r5.speaker: الماوردي
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p357/r5.claim: Al-Mawardi transmits a view that the surah is Medinan except from ‘be patient for your Lord’s judgment’ onward, which is Meccan.

MAJAZ:v2p279/r7.author: Abū ʿUbayda Maʿmar b. al-Muthannā
MAJAZ:v2p279/r7.speaker: author
MAJAZ:v2p279/r7.claim: Aw in lā tuṭiʿ athiman aw kafūran is not a choice; it means both a sinner and an unbeliever.
MAJAZ:v2p279/r7.anchor: «لا تطع منهم آثما أو كفورا» (24) ليس هاهنا تخيير أراد آثما وكفورا

NAHHAS:v5p106/r3.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p106/r3.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v5p106/r3.claim: The Prophet should bear their harm patiently; Qatada says this followed Abu Jahl's threat to stomp his neck.
NAHHAS:v5p106/r3.anchor: أي اصبر على أذاهم وكان السبب في نزول هذا على ما ذكر قتادة أن أبا جهل قال

NAHHAS:v5p106/r4.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p106/r4.speaker: الفراء
NAHHAS:v5p106/r4.claim: Al-Farrāʾ takes aw as equivalent to lā, forbidding obedience to a sinner or unbeliever.
NAHHAS:v5p106/r4.anchor: قال الفراء أو بمنزلة لا أي لا تطع من أثم ولا كفر

NAHHAS:v5p106/r5.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p106/r5.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v5p106/r5.claim: Abu Jaʿfar accepts aw as lā in interrogative, conditional, and negative contexts; he rejects aw as waw because its scope differs in commands not to speak to two people.
NAHHAS:v5p106/r5.anchor: قال أبو جعفر فالقول الأول صواب على قول سيبويه والثاني خطأ لا يكون أو بمعنى الواو

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p369/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p369/r5.speaker: الحسن وعكرمة والكلبي
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p369/r5.claim: They regard the surah as Medinan except for the closing passage beginning at verse 24, though they do not identify an earlier surah in which it was recited.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p369/r5.anchor: وقال الحسن وعكرمة والكلبي : هي مدنية إلا قوله : { ولا تطع منهم آثما أو كفورا }

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p414#2/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p414#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p414#2/r1.claim: The wording also forbids a leader to obey a sinful person or an unbeliever.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p414#2/r1.anchor: قال القاضي أبو محمد: واللفظ أيضا يقتضي نهي الإمام عن طاعة آثم من العصاة أو كفور من المشركين

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p414#2/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p414#2/r2.speaker: أبو عبيدة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p414#2/r2.claim: Abu Ubayda says أو means واو here, so the phrase offers no choice.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p414#2/r2.anchor: وقال أبو عبيدة: أو بمعنى الواو وليس في هذا تخيير

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p294/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p294/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p294/r1.claim: Because God bestowed the Qur’an, the Prophet should patiently accept His decree, refuse sinful or disbelieving people if they try to turn him from revelation, convey it, and trust God’s protection; “sinner” concerns deeds and “ungrateful disbeliever” the heart.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p294/r1.anchor: أي: كما أكرمتك بما أنزلت عليك، فاصبر على قضائه وقدره، واعلم أنه سيدبرك بحسن تدبيره،

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p172/r1.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p172/r1.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p172/r1.claim: The sinner or ingrate whom the Messenger must not obey may be Abu Jahl; an athim commits sins and a kafur denies blessings.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p172/r1.anchor: قيل إنه عنى أبا جهل , يريد بالآثم المرتكب للمعاصي , وبالكفور الجاحد للنعم .

MUQATIL:76:23-26/r2.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:76:23-26/r2.speaker: author
MUQATIL:76:23-26/r2.claim: At Dar al-Nadwa, al-Walid offered Muhammad half his wealth to abandon his message, Abu al-Bakhtari offered him a bride, and a third man claimed to protect him; Muhammad laughed, left, and revelation followed.
MUQATIL:76:23-26/r2.anchor: وذلك أنهم خلوا به في دار الندوة، وفيهم عمرو بن عمير بن مسعود الثقفي، فقالوا: يا محمد

MUQATIL:76:23-26/r3.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:76:23-26/r3.speaker: author
MUQATIL:76:23-26/r3.claim: The named sinner and unbeliever in the command are al-Walid ibn al-Mughira and Abu al-Bakhtari ibn Hisham; the source also associates the unbeliever label with Utba ibn Rabi'a.
MUQATIL:76:23-26/r3.anchor: { ولا تطع منهم آثما أو كفورا } [آية: 24] وهو الوليد بن المغيرة

QURTUBI-FULL:76:25-26/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:76:25-26/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:76:25-26/r1.claim: A cited poem shows that wa- or aw may carry the sense of “nor”; another view identifies the sinner as a hypocrite and the ingrate as an open disbeliever, close to al-Farra’s reading.
QURTUBI-FULL:76:25-26/r1.anchor: أراد ولا وجد شيخ. وقيل: الآثم المنافق، والكفور الكافر

RAZI-FULL:v30p228/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p228/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p228/r1.claim: Kafūr is the most wicked kind of sinner, singled out to emphasize the extreme of wickedness and distance from God.
RAZI-FULL:v30p228/r1.anchor: فخصه بالذكر تنبيها على غاية خبثه ونهاية بعده عن الله

RAZI-FULL:v30p228/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p228/r2.speaker: الزجاج وأكثر المحققين
RAZI-FULL:v30p228/r2.claim: Al-Zajjāj and most careful scholars prefer the wording 'or a sinner or an unbeliever': prohibiting obedience to either one also prohibits obedience to the pair, whereas a prohibition only against both together might allow obeying one alone.
RAZI-FULL:v30p228/r2.anchor: وهو الذي ذكره الزجاج واختاره أكثر المحققين

RAZI-FULL:v30p228/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p228/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p228/r3.claim: The author objects that the first grammatical argument is weak: forbidding one person's command does not necessarily forbid both when they agree, as a master may tell a servant to oppose one of two men but not both together.

RAZI-FULL:v30p228/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p228/r4.speaker: الفراء
RAZI-FULL:v30p228/r4.claim: Al-Farrāʾ reads the clause as 'do not obey any of them,' whether the person is sinful or an unbeliever, like refusing a request whether asked or silent.
RAZI-FULL:v30p228/r4.anchor: تقدير الآية لا تطع منهم أحدا

TABATABAI:76:1-22#5/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:76:1-22#5/r4.speaker: author
TABATABAI:76:1-22#5/r4.claim: The commands to be patient and not obey a sinner or unbeliever occur in a later, self-contained section that may have been revealed in Mecca, while the opening section concerning the Prophet's household was Medinan.
TABATABAI:76:1-22#5/r4.anchor: نازلا بمكة، ويؤيده ما في كثير من الروايات المتقدمة إن الذي نزل في أهل البيت بالمدينة هو الفصل الأول

TABATABAI:76:1-22#5/r5.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:76:1-22#5/r5.speaker: author
TABATABAI:76:1-22#5/r5.claim: Even if the entire sura came down at once, the command to patience does not by itself prove a Meccan date.
TABATABAI:76:1-22#5/r5.anchor: ولو سلم نزولها دفعة واحدة فأمره صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم بالصبر لا اختصاص له بالسور المكية

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p348/r1.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p348/r1.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p348/r1.claim: حكم can mean wisdom or judgment; asking the Prophet to be patient for God's حكم therefore encompasses both divine wisdom and decree, deliberately widening the meaning.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p348/r1.anchor: أمره بالصبر لهما معاً أي أن يصبر لحكمة أرادها الله تعالى ولحكم الله وقضائه

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p348/r2.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p348/r2.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p348/r2.claim: آثم covers outward or inward sin, while كفور intensifies disbelief or denial of blessings; every كفور is sinful but not every sinner is كفور, so the word bars both classes from obedience.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p348/r2.anchor: كل كفور آثم وليس كل آثم كفور

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p348/r3.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p348/r3.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p348/r3.claim: The author asks why the prohibition uses أو rather than و, raising a conjunction question without resolving it in this segment.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p348/r3.anchor: ما دلالة استعمال (أو) ولم يأتي بواو العطف مثلاً

RAZI-FULL:v30p227/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p227/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p227/r1.claim: One reading is patience while permission to fight is delayed, paralleling the command to wait until God judges between the parties.
RAZI-FULL:v30p227/r1.anchor: فإما أن يكون المعنى : { فاصبر لحكم ربك } في تأخير الإذن في القتال ونظيره { فاصبروا حتى يحكم الله بيننا وهو خير الحاكمين }

RAZI-FULL:v30p227/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p227/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p227/r2.claim: Alternatively, patience covers every duty, including worship, preaching, delivering the message, and enduring its hardships.
RAZI-FULL:v30p227/r2.anchor: أو يكون المعنى عاما في جميع التكاليف ، أي فاصبر في كل ما حكم به ربك سواء كان ذلك تكليفا خاصا بك من العبادات والطاعات

RAZI-FULL:v30p227/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p227/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p227/r3.claim: Although the patience command includes the later prohibition and reminder by implication, explicitly stating the positive duties first and prohibitions afterward adds clarity.
RAZI-FULL:v30p227/r3.anchor: الأول أمر بالمأمورات ، والثاني نهى عن المنهيات ودلالة أحدهما على الآخر بالالتزام لا بالتصريح فيكون التصريح به مفيدا

RAZI-FULL:v30p227/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p227/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p227/r4.claim: Though the Prophet would not obey them, the warning teaches people’s need for repeated guidance against corrupt desires; every believer must seek God’s protection from doubts and appetites.
RAZI-FULL:v30p227/r4.anchor: المقصود بيان أن الناس محتاجون إلى مواصلة التنبيه والإرشاد ، لأجل ما تركب فيهم من الشهوات الداعية إلى الفساد

RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r1.claim: Āthim is anyone who commits sin; the cited verses call associating partners, concealing testimony, hidden or open sin, and wine and gambling sin.
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r1.anchor: الآثم هو المقدم على المعاصي أي معصية كانت ، والكفور هو الجاحد للنعمة

RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r2.claim: Kafūr is one who denies God’s blessing; every disbeliever is sinful, but not every sinner is an unbeliever.
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r2.anchor: فكل كفور آثم ، أما ليس كل آثم كفورا

RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r3.claim: Anyone who worships other than God combines both descriptions by disobeying God and denying His beneficence.
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r3.anchor: كل من عبد غير الله فقد اجتمع في حقه هذان الوصفان ، لأنه لما عبد غيره ، فقد عصاه وجحد إنعامه

RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r4.claim: One view restricts the terms to particular people: some identify one person, Abū Jahl, with both descriptions.
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r4.anchor: أن المراد شخص معين ، ثم منهم من قال : الآثم ، والكفور هو شخص واحد وهو أبو جهل

RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r5.claim: Another specific identification assigns āthim to al-Walīd and kafūr to ʿUtba.
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r5.anchor: ومنهم من قال : الآثم هو الوليد والكفور هو عتبة

RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r6.speaker: القفال
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r6.claim: Al-Qaffāl supports identifying al-Walīd as sinful because the Qur’an calls him athīm in al-Qalam.
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r6.anchor: قال القفال : ويدل عليه أنه تعالى سمى الوليد أثيما في قوله : { ولا تطع كل حلاف مهين }

RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r7.speaker: صاحب الكشاف
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r7.claim: Al-Kashshāf reverses the identification: ʿUtba is sinful for his many transgressions, while al-Walīd is the disbeliever for his extreme unbelief.
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r7.anchor: وروى صاحب الكشاف أن الآثم هو عتبة . والكفور هو الوليد لأن عتبة كان ركابا للمآثم متعاطيا لأنواع الفسوق

RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r8.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r8.speaker: عتبة بن ربيعة
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r8.claim: A report says ʿUtba offered the Prophet marriage to his daughters if he abandoned his mission, while al-Walīd offered money; the Prophet recited the opening of Fuṣṣilat, and they left fearing punishment.
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r8.anchor: يروى أن عتبة بن ربيعة قال للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم : ارجع عن هذا الأمر حتى أزوجك ولدي

RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r9.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r9.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r9.claim: Al-Rāzī prefers the single-person identification because he considers it supported by Qur’anic evidence.
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r9.anchor: والقول الأول أولى لأنه متأيد بالقرآن

RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r10.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r10.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r10.claim: The closer-to-the-apparent reading takes both terms generally rather than limiting them to named individuals.
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r10.anchor: أن الآثم والكفور مطلقان غير مختصين بشخص معين ، وهذا هو الأقرب إلى الظاهر

RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r11.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r11.speaker: الحسن
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r11.claim: Al-Ḥasan identifies the sinner as a hypocrite and the disbeliever as the Arab polytheists.
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r11.anchor: ثم قال الحسن الآثم هو المنافق والكفور مشركوا العرب

RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r12.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r12.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r12.claim: Al-Rāzī rejects al-Ḥasan’s division as weak: the sinner is general, while the disbeliever is a narrower category.
RAZI-FULL:v30p227#2/r12.anchor: وهذا ضعيف بل الحق ما ذكرناه من أن الآثم عام والكفور خاص

STUDYQURAN:76:24/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:76:24/r1.speaker: JJ, Ṭs
STUDYQURAN:76:24/r1.claim: This counsels the Prophet to endure opposition from Quraysh leaders ʿUtbah ibn Rabīʿah and al-Walīd ibn al-Mughīrah, who told him to abandon his mission.
STUDYQURAN:76:24/r1.anchor: This verse is taken as counsel to the Prophet to be patient in the face of the opposition from ʿUtbah ibn Rabīʿah and al-Walīd ibn al-Mughīrah

STUDYQURAN:76:24/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:76:24/r2.speaker: JJ
STUDYQURAN:76:24/r2.claim: “Sinner” and “disbeliever” specifically refer to ʿUtbah and al-Walīd.
STUDYQURAN:76:24/r2.anchor: Sinner and disbeliever can thus be understood both as a specific reference to these two men

STUDYQURAN:76:24/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:76:24/r3.speaker: JJ
STUDYQURAN:76:24/r3.claim: The terms can also refer generally to all sinners and disbelievers.
STUDYQURAN:76:24/r3.anchor: as a more general reference to all sinners and disbelievers

TAB-FULL:v23p572#2/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p572#2/r2.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v23p572#2/r2.claim: He must patiently bear his Lord’s tests, fulfill the obligations imposed on him, deliver the messages, and carry out what the revelation requires.
TAB-FULL:v23p572#2/r2.anchor: عن قتادة، قوله: {ولا تطع منهم آثما أو كفورا} [الإنسان: 24] قال: نزلت في عدو الله أبي جهل

TAB-FULL:v23p572#2/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p572#2/r3.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v23p572#2/r3.claim: He must not obey a sinful or ungrateful polytheist in disobeying God; the sinner commits wrongdoing, while the ingrate denies God’s favors and worships another.
TAB-FULL:v23p572#2/r3.anchor: ولا تطع في معصية الله من مشركي قومك آثما

TAB-FULL:v23p572#2/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p572#2/r4.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v23p572#2/r4.claim: Qatāda says the verse was revealed concerning Abū Jahl.
TAB-FULL:v23p572#2/r4.anchor: عن قتادة، قوله: {ولا تطع منهم آثما أو كفورا} [الإنسان: 24] قال: نزلت في عدو الله أبي جهل

TAB-FULL:v23p572#2/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p572#2/r5.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v23p572#2/r5.claim: Qatāda reports that Abū Jahl threatened to trample Muhammad’s neck if he saw him praying, after which the verse was revealed.
TAB-FULL:v23p572#2/r5.anchor: عن قتادة أنه بلغه أن أبا جهل، قال: لئن رأيت محمدا يصلي لأطأن عنقه

TAB-FULL:v23p572#2/r6.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p572#2/r6.speaker: ابن زيد
TAB-FULL:v23p572#2/r6.claim: Ibn Zayd glosses the sinner as a wrongdoing offender and says sinner and ingrate describe one and the same person here.
TAB-FULL:v23p572#2/r6.anchor: قال ابن زيد، في قوله: {ولا تطع منهم آثما أو كفورا}

TAB-FULL:v23p572#2/r7.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p572#2/r7.speaker: الفراء
TAB-FULL:v23p572#2/r7.claim: Al-Farrāʾ says أو can function like و here; in negated constructions it may have that sense, as in the cited poetic line where أو means “nor.”
TAB-FULL:v23p572#2/r7.anchor: قال الفراء: أو ههنا بمنزلة الواو

TAB-FULL:v23p572#2/r8.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p572#2/r8.speaker: الفراء
TAB-FULL:v23p572#2/r8.claim: Al-Farrāʾ illustrates the sense with “do not obey whoever sins or disbelieves” and “I will give whether you ask or stay silent.”
TAB-FULL:v23p572#2/r8.anchor: قال: وقد يكون في العربية: لا تطيعن منهم من أثم أو كفر

BURSEVI:v10p213#2/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p213#2/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p213#2/r4.claim: Be patient while victory over the unbelievers is delayed; the outcome is good, retaliation should not be rushed, and every matter arrives at its appointed time.
BURSEVI:v10p213#2/r4.anchor: بتأخير نصرك على الكافرين فإن له عاقبة حميدة ولا تستعجل في أمر المقابلة والانتقام

BURSEVI:v10p213#2/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p213#2/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p213#2/r5.claim: منهم refers to the unbelievers; do not obey either a sinner calling to sin or an extreme disbeliever calling to disbelief.
BURSEVI:v10p213#2/r5.anchor: لا تطع كل واحد من مرتكب الإثك الداعي لك إليه

BURSEVI:v10p213#2/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p213#2/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p213#2/r6.claim: Under a prohibition, أو distributes the ban over either of the two alternatives: do not obey one or the other, meaning do not obey either one.
BURSEVI:v10p213#2/r6.anchor: فكذا إذ قلت في النهي لا تكلم زيدا أو عمرا كان التقدير لا تكلم أحدهما

BURSEVI:v10p213#2/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p213#2/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p213#2/r7.claim: The division concerns what the callers urge, since all are unbelievers; the general “sinner” excludes the specific sin of unbelief, the worst kind of sin, though a sinner may also be a follower and a disbeliever a leader.
BURSEVI:v10p213#2/r7.anchor: لأنهم كانوا كفرة والكفر أخبث أنواع الإثم فلا معنى للقسمة

THALABI:v10p105#2/r1.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p105#2/r1.speaker: النبي
THALABI:v10p105#2/r1.claim: The Prophet promises the Ethiopian questioner Paradise and says a black person will see its splendor from a thousand years away; saying the shahada earns a divine covenant, while tasbih earns 124,000 good deeds.
THALABI:v10p105#2/r1.anchor: «والذي نفسي بيده ليرى بياض الأسود في الجنة مسيرة ألف عام» ، ثم قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم «من قال لا إله إلا الله

THALABI:v10p105#2/r2.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p105#2/r2.speaker: النبي
THALABI:v10p105#2/r2.claim: The Prophet says a person's deeds may weigh down a mountain, yet one divine blessing nearly exhausts them unless God grants mercy.
THALABI:v10p105#2/r2.anchor: إن الرجل ليأتي يوم القيامة لو وضع على جبل لأثقله، قال: فتقوم النعمة من نعم الله سبحانه فيكاد أن تستنفد ذلك كله

THALABI:v10p105#2/r6.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p105#2/r6.speaker: author
THALABI:v10p105#2/r6.claim: The Prophet is commanded to be patient with God's decree.
THALABI:v10p105#2/r6.anchor: فاصبر لحكم ربك ولا تطع منهم آثما أو كفورا

THALABI:v10p105#2/r7.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p105#2/r7.speaker: author
THALABI:v10p105#2/r7.claim: The author glosses the conjunction as “and,” with its alif treated as an addition.

THALABI:v10p105#2/r8.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p105#2/r8.speaker: الفراء
THALABI:v10p105#2/r8.claim: Al-Farraʾ says aw can mean wa, adducing a poem whose final “or” means “nor.”
THALABI:v10p105#2/r8.anchor: وقال الفراء: أو معنى [ .... ] كقول الشاعر: لا وجد ثكلى كما وجدت ولا

THALABI:v10p105#2/r9.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p105#2/r9.speaker: قتادة
THALABI:v10p105#2/r9.claim: Qatada equates the sinner with the disbeliever and says the verse forbade obeying Abu Jahl, who threatened to trample the Prophet's neck if he prayed.
THALABI:v10p105#2/r9.anchor: قال قتادة: الآثم: الكفور، نهى الله سبحانه وتعالى نبيه عن طاعة أبو جهل

THALABI:v10p105#2/r10.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p105#2/r10.speaker: مقاتل
THALABI:v10p105#2/r10.claim: Muqatil identifies the sinful one as ʿUtba ibn Rabiʿa, who offered the Prophet a beautiful daughter and marriage without a dowry if he abandoned his mission.
THALABI:v10p105#2/r10.anchor: وقال مقاتل: ولا تطع منهم يعني من مشركي مكة أنها تعني عتبة بن ربيعة

THALABI:v10p105#2/r11.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p105#2/r11.speaker: مقاتل
THALABI:v10p105#2/r11.claim: Muqatil identifies the disbeliever as al-Walid ibn al-Mughira, who offered money until the Prophet was satisfied if he abandoned his mission.
THALABI:v10p105#2/r11.anchor: أو كفورا يعني الوليد بن المغيرة قال للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p57#3/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p57#3/r1.speaker: الكلبي
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p57#3/r1.claim: Al-Kalbi says this sura and its verses were revealed in installments, unlike other scriptures; Muqatil agrees.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p57#3/r1.anchor: قال الكلبي: السورة، والآية، والآيتين لم تنزل جملة واحدة

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p57#3/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p57#3/r2.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p57#3/r2.anchor: {ولا تطع منهم} يعني: من مشركي مكة

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p57#3/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p57#3/r3.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p57#3/r3.claim: The sinful person is Utba ibn Rabiʿa, who asked the Prophet to abandon his mission and offered to marry him to one of his children.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p57#3/r3.anchor: آثما} يعني: عتبة بن ربيعة، قال للنبي -صلى الله عليه وسلم-

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p57#3/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p57#3/r4.speaker: الكلبي، مقاتل
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p57#3/r4.claim: The ungrateful person is al-Walid ibn al-Mughira, who offered wealth until the Prophet was satisfied and boasted of his riches.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p57#3/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p57#3/r5.speaker: الفراء
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p57#3/r5.claim: Al-Farra says aw here functions like lā, supported by a verse where it means “nor”; it can also approach wāw and encompass either case.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p57#3/r5.anchor: قال الفراء: (أو) هاهنا بمنزلة (لا)، وأنشد (¬10)، فقال:

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p57#3/r6.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p57#3/r6.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p57#3/r6.claim: Farra’s example means “I will give you whether you ask or remain silent,” illustrating aw close to wāw in the sense of “in any case.”
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p57#3/r6.anchor: كقولك للرجل: لأعطينك سألت، أو سكت، معناه: لأعطينك على كل حال

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p57#3/r7.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p57#3/r7.speaker: قتادة
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p57#3/r7.claim: Qatada says Abu Jahl threatened to step on Muhammad’s neck if he saw him praying, prompting this command.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p57#3/r7.anchor: وعلى هذا يتجه قول قتادة: إن أبا جهل قال

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p57#3/r8.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p57#3/r8.speaker: الزجاج
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p57#3/r8.claim: Al-Zajjaj says aw is stronger than wāw because it makes each person individually someone not to obey; he compares Zayd and Amr with al-Hasan and Ibn Sirin.

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:76:24/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:76:24/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:76:24/r1.claim: The sinner is ʿUtba ibn Rabīʿa, and the unbeliever is al-Walīd ibn al-Mughīra.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:76:24/r1.anchor: { ولا تطع منهم آثما } يعني: عتبة بن ربيعة { أو كفورا } يعني: الوليد بن المغيرة

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:76:24/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:76:24/r2.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:76:24/r2.claim: The two men promised the Prophet wealth and marriage if he stopped calling them to Islam.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:76:24/r2.anchor: وذلك أنهما ضمنا للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم المال والتزويج إن ترك دعوتهم إلى الإسلام.

ELMALILI:76:23-24/r5.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:76:23-24/r5.speaker: author
ELMALILI:76:23-24/r5.claim: The Prophet should not hurry: he must endure the duties, trials, toil, and struggle God has imposed, await His future judgment, and trust that these hardships have a good outcome.
ELMALILI:76:23-24/r5.anchor: Onun için acele etme de Rabbinin hükmünü vermesi için sabret bugün son nusret ve muvaffakiyete erdirivermeyip de mükellef ve mübtelâ kıldığı birtakım mesâî ve mücahedelerin zorluğuna tahammül et

ELMALILI:76:23-24/r6.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:76:23-24/r6.speaker: author
ELMALILI:76:23-24/r6.claim: Do not obey a sinner who calls people to sin or an ungrateful disbeliever who calls them to disbelief.
ELMALILI:76:23-24/r6.anchor: {وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ} Sabırsızlık edip de o insanlar içinden {ءَاثِمًا} bir âsime günaha davet eden bir günahkâra

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:76:23/r2.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:76:23/r2.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:76:23/r2.claim: These verses remind the Prophet of revelation’s value and urge him to remain steadfast in worship and carrying out God’s commands, strengthening his resolve against the deniers.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:76:23/r2.anchor: Bu âyetler ise Hz. Peygamber’e vahyin değerini hatırlatıyor; Allah’ın hükümlerini yerine getirmede kararlı olup ibadet etmesini öğütlüyor.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:76:23/r3.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:76:23/r3.speaker: tefsirlerde
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:76:23/r3.claim: Exegetical accounts say Meccan leaders offered the Prophet wealth, status, and prestige to stop opposing their religion and unjust order; he rejected the offers, refused to abandon his mission, and recited Fussilat 41:1–3.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:76:23/r3.anchor: Nitekim tefsirlerde anlatıldığına göre Mekke’nin önde gelen müşrikleri Hz. Peygamber’den kendi dinlerine ve haksız düzenlerine karşı açtığı mücadeleyi durdurmasını istemişler

BURHAN:v2p199/r2.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v2p199/r2.speaker: author
BURHAN:v2p199/r2.claim: One way to resolve a difficult phrase is to recast it against its opposite: the prohibition means obey neither the sinner nor the disbeliever.
BURHAN:v2p199/r2.anchor: أحدها رد الكلمة لضدها كقوله تعالى ﴿ ولا تطع منهم آثما أو كفورا ﴾ أي ولا كفورا

BURHAN:v4p145/r2.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v4p145/r2.speaker: author
BURHAN:v4p145/r2.claim: This is parallel: the prohibition must remain applicable to either alternative without restricting it to a specific one.
BURHAN:v4p145/r2.anchor: ونظيره ﴿ ولا تطع منهم آثما أو كفورا ﴾

BURHAN:v4p211/r1.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v4p211/r1.speaker: author
BURHAN:v4p211/r1.claim: Here أو remains in its ordinary sense: the ban covers obeying either sinner or ingrate alone, as well as obeying both; it avoids suggesting that only someone bearing both traits is forbidden.
BURHAN:v4p211/r1.anchor: فليس المراد منه النهي عن اطاعة احدهما دون الآخر بل النهي عن طاعتهما

BURHAN:v4p211/r2.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v4p211/r2.speaker: ابن الحاجب
BURHAN:v4p211/r2.claim: Some object that أو in a prohibition seems to allow compliance by avoiding one alternative, though true compliance requires avoiding both.
BURHAN:v4p211/r2.anchor: وقال ابن الحاجب استشكل قوم وقوع أو في النهي في هذه الاية

BURHAN:v4p211/r3.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v4p211/r3.speaker: author
BURHAN:v4p211/r3.claim: The ordinary meaning of أو is preferable: the negative prohibition makes the indefinite object universal, so the scope over both alternatives comes from negation, not from أو.
BURHAN:v4p211/r3.anchor: والاولى انها على بابها وانما جاء التعيين فيها من القرينة

BURHAN:v4p211/r5.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v4p211/r5.speaker: أبو البقاء
BURHAN:v4p211/r5.claim: Abu al-Baqa says grammarians require avoiding both alternatives after أو in a prohibition; doing both violates the prohibition twice because each is independently forbidden.
BURHAN:v4p211/r5.anchor: إن اتصلت بالنهي وجب اجتناب الامرين عند النحويين

BURHAN:v4p211/r6.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v4p211/r6.speaker: سيبويه
BURHAN:v4p211/r6.claim: Sibawayh treats أو in prohibition as the converse of أو in permission: do not obey this one or that one, with each alternative individually prohibited.
BURHAN:v4p211/r6.anchor: وقال في موضع آخر مذهب سيبويه إن أو في النهي نقيضية أو في الاباحة

BURHAN:v4p213/r1.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v4p213/r1.speaker: قيل
BURHAN:v4p213/r1.claim: One view makes أو equivalent to waw because abstaining from only one alternative would not count as compliance; al-Khatibi instead favors its ordinary sense, with generality supplied by negation.
BURHAN:v4p213/r1.anchor: وقيل أو بمعنى الواو لانه لو انتهى عن احدهما لم يعد ممتثلا بالانتهاء عنهما جميعا

ITQAN:v1p44/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v1p44/r4.speaker: author
ITQAN:v1p44/r4.claim: Al-Insān is said to be Medinan or Meccan except for the verse prohibiting obedience to a sinner or ingrate.
ITQAN:v1p44/r4.anchor: سورة الإنسان قيل مدنية وقيل مكية إلا آية واحدة ﴿ ولا تطع منهم آثما أو كفورا ﴾

ITQAN:v2p458/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v2p458/r1.speaker: author
ITQAN:v2p458/r1.claim: Early grammarians described aw simply as offering one of two or more alternatives; Ibn Hishām says that is the sound account and the further meanings are inferred from context.
ITQAN:v2p458/r1.anchor: لم يذكر المتقدمون لأو هذه المعاني بل قالوا هي لأحد الشيئين أو الأشياء قال ابن هشام وهو التحقيق والمعاني المذكورة مستفادة من القرائن

ITQAN:v2p458/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v2p458/r2.speaker: أبو البقاء
ITQAN:v2p458/r2.claim: Abū al-Baqāʾ says aw in a prohibition is the opposite of aw in permission: both alternatives must be avoided, and doing both compounds the violation.
ITQAN:v2p458/r2.anchor: قال أبو البقاء أو في النهي نقيضة أو في الإباحة فيجب اجتناب الأمرين كقوله ﴿ ولا تطع منهم آثما أو كفورا ﴾

ITQAN:v2p458/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v2p458/r3.speaker: غيره
ITQAN:v2p458/r3.claim: Another view takes aw in this kind of phrase to mean waw and indicate combination.
ITQAN:v2p458/r3.anchor: وقال غيره أو في مثل هذا بمعنى الواو تفيد الجمع

ITQAN:v2p458/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v2p458/r4.speaker: الطيبي
ITQAN:v2p458/r4.claim: Al-Ṭībī prefers the ordinary disjunctive meaning: the prohibition plus the negative context makes the indefinite phrase general, meaning do not obey either one.
ITQAN:v2p458/r4.anchor: وقال الطيبي الأولى أنها على بابها وإنما جاء التعميم فيما من النهي الذي فيه معنى النفي والنكرة في سياق النفي تعم

ITQAN:v2p458/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v2p458/r5.speaker: author
ITQAN:v2p458/r5.claim: Because aw does not combine its alternatives, a pronoun referring to its two singular alternatives remains singular, unlike with waw.
ITQAN:v2p458/r5.anchor: لكون مبناها على عدم التشريك عاد الضمير إلى مفرديها بالإفراد بخلاف الواو

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p108/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p108/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p108/r1.claim: The particle aw can express doubt, as in seeing Zayd or ʿAmr, or choice, as when selecting a coin or its value in silver.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p108/r1.anchor: ' أو ' : حرف يرد للشك . تقول : رأيت زيدا أو عمرا . ويرد للتخيير

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p108/r7.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p108/r7.speaker: أهل التفسير
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p108/r7.claim: A second Quranic use is waw, “and,” including “perhaps he will remember and fear” and “do not obey a sinner or an ingrate.”
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p108/r7.anchor: وذكر أهل التفسير أن ' أو ' في القرآن على ثلاثة أوجه

FARRA:v3p219/r1.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p219/r1.speaker: author
FARRA:v3p219/r1.claim: In negation, interrogation, and conditional clauses, أو can mean لا; the unnamed poet's final أو is intended as ولا.
FARRA:v3p219/r1.anchor: وأو فى الجحد والاستفهام والجزاء تكون في معنى (لا) فهذا من ذلك

FARRA:v3p219/r2.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p219/r2.speaker: author
FARRA:v3p219/r2.claim: Alternatively, أو can approach واو in a promise: لأعطينك سألت أو سكت means I will give you in any case.
FARRA:v3p219/r2.anchor: لا تطيعن منهم من أثم أو كفر

SAMIN-DURR:76:24/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:76:24/r1.speaker: سيبويه
SAMIN-DURR:76:24/r1.claim: Sibawayh takes أو in its ordinary disjunctive sense; in a prohibition, forbidding either alternative bars both, so the meaning is obey neither a sinner nor an unbeliever.
SAMIN-DURR:76:24/r1.anchor: أنها على بابها، وهو قول سيبويه. قال أبو البقاء: " وتفيد في النهي [المنع] عن الجميع

SAMIN-DURR:76:24/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:76:24/r2.speaker: أبو البقاء
SAMIN-DURR:76:24/r2.claim: Abu al-Baqa explains that forbidding speech to Zayd or Amr prohibits either one; the verse thus means do not obey either of them.
SAMIN-DURR:76:24/r2.anchor: فإذا نهى فقال: " لا تكلم زيدا أو عمرا " فالتقدير: لا تكلم أحدها

SAMIN-DURR:76:24/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:76:24/r3.speaker: الزمخشري
SAMIN-DURR:76:24/r3.claim: Al-Zamakhshari answers that prohibiting obedience to one entails prohibiting both; like forbidding even saying uff to one's parents, it rules out striking them a fortiori.
SAMIN-DURR:76:24/r3.anchor: إذا نهي أن يقول لأبويه: " أف " علم أنه منهي عن ضربهما على طريق الأولى

SAMIN-DURR:76:24/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:76:24/r4.speaker: الفراء
SAMIN-DURR:76:24/r4.claim: Al-Farra, as reported by Makki, takes أو to mean لا, yielding do not obey one who sins or one who disbelieves.
SAMIN-DURR:76:24/r4.anchor: الثاني: أنها بمعنى " لا " ، أي: لا تطع من أثم ولا من كفر. قال مكي: " وهو قول الفراء

SAMIN-DURR:76:24/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:76:24/r5.speaker: الكوفيون
SAMIN-DURR:76:24/r5.claim: The Kufans take أو in the sense of الواو, as discussed earlier in the source.
SAMIN-DURR:76:24/r5.anchor: الثالث: أنها بمعنى الواو، وقد تقدم أن ذلك قول الكوفيين وتقدمت أدلتهم

SAMIN-DURR:76:24/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:76:24/r6.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:76:24/r6.claim: One interpretation identifies the sinner as Utba and the unbeliever as al-Walid, treating the alternatives as two particular people.
SAMIN-DURR:76:24/r6.anchor: وفي التفسير: الآثم عتبة، والكفور الوليد

SAMIN-DURR:76:24/r7.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:76:24/r7.speaker: الزمخشري
SAMIN-DURR:76:24/r7.claim: Although all the addressees were unbelievers, al-Zamakhshari distinguishes invitations to assist in a sinful act, a disbelief, or neither; the prohibition covers the first two.
SAMIN-DURR:76:24/r7.anchor: الزمخشري قال: " فإن قلت: كانوا كلهم كفرة فما معنى القسمة

ASAD-NOTES:76:23#n22/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:76:23#n22/r1.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:76:23#n22/r1.claim: Asad links the instruction to patience under God's judgment with the preceding promises: the righteous meet bliss and evildoers suffering in the hereafter.
ASAD-NOTES:76:23#n22/r1.anchor: This connects with the preceding mention of the life to come, in which the righteous will meet with bliss, and the evildoers with suffering.

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p347/r2.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p347/r2.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p347/r2.claim: The command to be patient follows the Quran's descent because its weighty message, duties, and the harm the Prophet will face all demand patience.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p347/r2.anchor: ثم أمره بالصبر بعد ذكر تنزيل القرآن لأن التنزيل يستدعي الصبر لما فيه من قول ثقيل وأمور وتكاليف تستدعي الصبر

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p349/r1.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p349/r1.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p349/r1.claim: The choice of أو forbids obeying either wrongdoer, whether singly or together; واو could have allowed obeying one of them.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p349/r1.anchor: لو جاء بالواو لجاز له أن يطيع أحدهما إنما استعمال (أو) دلّت على الأمر بأن لا يطيع واحداً منهما على سبيل الجمع أو الإفراد

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p349/r2.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p349/r2.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p349/r2.claim: آثم is an active participle and أثيم an intensive adjective; naming even the lesser sinner forbids obeying him, so an intensive sinner is a fortiori excluded.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p349/r2.anchor: والآثم هو اسم فاعل والأثيم صفة مبالغة وفي هذه الآية أراد تعالى أن لا يطيع الآثم سواء بالغ في الإثم أو لم يبالغ

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p349/r3.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p349/r3.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p349/r3.claim: Al-Qalam uses intensive أثيم amid a series of intensive traits; each listed deed makes its doer أثيم, and their combination makes the form especially apt.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p349/r3.anchor: في سورة القلم قال تعالى (منّاع للخير معتد أثيم (12)) باستخدام الأثيم لأنه لو لاحظنا ما ورد

ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p339/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p339/r1.speaker: قتادة
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p339/r1.claim: Qatāda reports that Abū Jahl vowed to trample Muhammad's neck if he saw him praying, and says this verse was revealed in response.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p339/r1.anchor: عن قتادة أنه بلغه أن أبا جهل يقول لئن رأيت محمدا يصلي لأطأن على عنقه فأنزل الله عز وجل

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابالواوالتيتدخلعليهاألفالا.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابالواوالتيتدخلعليهاألفالا.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابالواوالتيتدخلعليهاألفالا.claim: In the negative command, أو connects the two objects under one prohibition; repeating لا after أو would change the meaning.
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابالواوالتيتدخلعليهاألفالا.anchor: لو قلت أو لا تطع كفورا انقلب المعنى

ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r1.claim: Be patient with the Lord’s decree that victory over the unbelievers is delayed; its outcome is praiseworthy.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r1.anchor: فاصبر لحكم ربك بتأخير نصرك على الكفار فإن له عاقبة حميدة

ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r2.claim: Do not obey either a sinful person or an unbeliever when they invite you to sin or disbelief; the attributes explain why obedience is forbidden, not every neutral matter.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r2.anchor: والمراد ولا تطع مرتكب الأثم الداعي لك إليه أو مرتكب الكفر الداعي إليه أيلا تتبع أحدا من الآثم إذا دعاك إلى الأثم

ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r3.speaker: ابن الحاجب
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r3.claim: Ibn al-Hajib says أو assigns a ruling to one of two matters; context turns it into permission when either option is independently acceptable, as in sitting with Hasan or Ibn Sirin.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r3.anchor: ابن الحاجب حيث قال إن وضع أو لأثبات الحكم لأحد الأمرين

ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r4.speaker: أبو عبيدة
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r4.claim: Some interpreters, including Abu Ubayda, take أو here to mean واو because a prohibition would not be fulfilled by avoiding only one person.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r4.anchor: واستشكل بعضهم وقوعها في النهي كلاتطع منهم آثما أو كفورا إذ لو انتهى عن أحدهم الم يتمثل ومن ثم حملها بعضهم يعني أبا عبيدة على أنها بمعنى الواو

ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r5.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r5.claim: Al-Alusi keeps أو in its ordinary sense: the underlying positive proposition is obeying either one, and negating it means obey neither, so the prohibition covers both.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r5.anchor: والأولى إن تبقى على بابها وإنما جاء التعميم فيها من وراء ذلك وهو النهي الذي فيه معنى النفي لأن المعنى قبل وجود النهي تطيع آثما أو كفورا أيواحدا منهما

ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r6.speaker: الزجاج
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r6.claim: Al-Zajjaj calls أو stronger than واو: with واو, refusing one while obeying the other would not count as disobeying both, whereas أو marks each as someone not to obey.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r6.anchor: وقريب من ذلك قول الزجاج أن أو ههنا أوكد من الواو لأنك إذا قلت لا تطع زيدا وعمرا فأطا أحدهما كان غير عاص

ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r7.speaker: جار الله
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r7.claim: Jar Allah keeps أو in its literal sense and says the ban on obeying both follows by textual implication, whether equal or a fortiori.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r7.anchor: وأفاد جار الله إن أو باقية على حقيقتها وإن النهي عن إطاعتهما جميعاإنما جاء دلالة النص

ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r8.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r8.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r8.claim: The labels may denote hypocrites and openly idolatrous disbelievers, respectively, or specifically ‘Utbah ibn Rabi‘ah and al-Walid ibn al-Mughirah.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r8.anchor: وقيل الآثم المنافق والكفور المشرك المجاهر وقيل الآثم عتبة بن ربيعة والكفور الوليد بن المغيرة

ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r9.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r9.speaker: مقاتل
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r9.claim: Muqatil says the two told the Prophet to abandon his mission and promised wealth and marriage to satisfy him; the verse was revealed in response.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r9.anchor: وعن مقاتل أنهما قالا له صلى الله تعالى عليه وسلم ارجع عن هذا الأمر ونحن نرضيك بالمال والتزويج فنزلت

ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r10.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r10.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r10.claim: Another report identifies the unbeliever as Abu Jahl and says the verse was revealed about him.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r10.anchor: وقيل المفور أبو جهل والآية نزلت فيه

ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r11.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r11.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r11.claim: The verse is not proof against praying behind a sinful imam, because it forbids following such a person in sin, not following him in neutral acts such as leading prayer.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r11.anchor: فلا يتم الأستدلال بالآية على عدم جواز الأقتداء بالفاسق إذا صلى إماما

ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r12.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r12.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r12.claim: Given the Prophet’s protection from sin, the command also guides others to seek God’s help and refuge from falling into wrongdoing.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p165#2/r12.anchor: والأولى ما تقدمو في النهي مع العصمة إرشاد لغيرالمعصوم

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p289/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p289/r1.speaker: عطاء
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p289/r1.claim: Ata says Surat al-Insan is Meccan.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p289/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p289/r2.speaker: مجاهد وقتادة
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p289/r2.claim: Mujahid and Qatada say Surat al-Insan is Medinan.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p289/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p289/r3.speaker: الحسن وعكرمة
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p289/r3.claim: Al-Hasan and Ikrima say the surah is Medinan except for verse 24.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p289/r3.anchor: وقال الحسن وعكرمة: هي مدنية إلا آية وهي قوله: "فاصبر لحكم ربك ولا تطع منهم آثما أو كفورا"

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p298#2/r4.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p298#2/r4.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p298#2/r4.claim: The command is to be patient with God's decree and not obey a sinner or disbeliever among the Meccan polytheists; the conjunction means and.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p298#2/r4.anchor: يعني من مشركي مكة {آثما أو كفورا} يعني وكفورا،

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p298#2/r5.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p298#2/r5.speaker: قتادة
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p298#2/r5.claim: Qatada identifies the sinner-disbeliever as Abu Jahl, who forbade the Prophet to pray and threatened to trample his neck if he saw him praying.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p298#2/r5.anchor: قال قتادة: أراد بالآثم الكفور أبا جهل وذلك أنه لما فرضت الصلاة على النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p298#2/r6.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p298#2/r6.speaker: مقاتل
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p298#2/r6.claim: Muqatil identifies the sinner as Utbah ibn Rabiʿah and the disbeliever as al-Walid ibn al-Mughira, who offered the Prophet wealth or marriage if he abandoned his mission; the verse followed.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p298#2/r6.anchor: وقال مقاتل: أراد ب"الآثم" عتبة بن ربيعة وب"الكفور" الوليد بن المغيرة، قالا للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

BAYDAWI-FULL:76:22-24/r5.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:76:22-24/r5.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:76:22-24/r5.claim: The Prophet is to endure the delay of victory over Mecca's unbelievers and others.
BAYDAWI-FULL:76:22-24/r5.anchor: بتأخير نصرك على كفار مكة وغيرهم

BAYDAWI-FULL:76:22-24/r6.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:76:22-24/r6.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:76:22-24/r6.claim: The warning covers any sinner or persistent unbeliever who urges the Prophet toward sin or unbelief.
BAYDAWI-FULL:76:22-24/r6.anchor: أي كل واحد من مرتكب الإثم الداعي لك إليه ومن الغالي في الكفر الداعي لك إليه

BAYDAWI-FULL:76:22-24/r7.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:76:22-24/r7.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:76:22-24/r7.claim: Aw shows the two types are equally and independently deserving of disobedience; the prohibition concerns what they invite him to do, since compliance in something neither sinful nor unbelieving is not forbidden.
BAYDAWI-FULL:76:22-24/r7.anchor: وأو للدلالة على أنهما سيان في استحقاق العصيان والاستقلال به والقسم باعتبار ما يدعونه إليه

BAYDAWI-FULL:76:22-24/r8.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:76:22-24/r8.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:76:22-24/r8.claim: Following either person in an act that is neither sin nor unbelief is not prohibited; the command forbids yielding to their sinful or unbelieving demands.
BAYDAWI-FULL:76:22-24/r8.anchor: فإن مطاوعتهما فيما ليس بإثم ولا كفر غير محظور

BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r1.claim: The instruction is framed alongside the warning in al-Muddaththir, the weighty Qur'anic message in al-Muzzammil, and the reminder not to move one's tongue in al-Qiyama; the sūra of al-Jinn also treats the Qur'an.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r1.anchor: { لا تحرك به لسانك } ) 77 [ القيامة : 16 ] الملتفتة إلى ما في المدثر من أن هذه تذكرة

BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r2.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r2.claim: The Qur'an chiefly establishes its own greatness as the central miraculous sign; once that sign is established, the rest of the law follows. A wise speaker repeats a resisted point indirectly until it settles in the hearer's mind.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r2.anchor: فإنه المقصود بالذات من أمر الآية الكبرى التي إذا ثبتت تبعها جميع المراد من الشريعة

BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r3.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r3.claim: The Prophet is to endure God's decree concerning those whom He has judged astray, and whatever befalls him, obeying God's commands; he should recall that a compassionate nurturer educates through hardship and ease according to wisdom.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r3.anchor: أي المحسن إليك بتخصيصه لك بهذه النعمة على ضلال من حكم بضلاله

BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r4.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r4.claim: Patience is restraining and steadying the self against desire so it does not follow blameworthy pleasures.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r4.anchor: والصبر : حبس النفس وضبطها على مقاومة الهوى لئلا تنقاد إلى شيء من قبائح اللذات

BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r5.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r5.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r5.claim: The opponents who solicit obedience are the unbelievers, opposed to the grateful; the prohibition names those inviting to sin or unbelief, leaving unmentioned cases outside this particular ban.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r5.anchor: وكان المخالفون له صلى الله عليه وسلم هم القسم المضاد للشاكر وهم الكفرة

BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r6.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r6.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r6.claim: An athim is someone who invites the Prophet to sin, whether or not that sin is joined to unbelief.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r6.anchor: أي داعيا إلى إثم سواء كان مجردا عن مطلق الكفر أو مصاحبا له

BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r7.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r7.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r7.claim: A kafur is an emphatic unbeliever who calls others to unbelief; worldly power and greatness do not outweigh the truth.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r7.anchor: أي مبالغا في الكفر وداعيا إليه وإن كان كبيرا وعظيما في الدنيا فإن الحق أكبر من كل كبير

BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r8.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r8.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r8.claim: Despite severely harming the Prophet, the opponents offered him wealth, control, and marriage to their most eminent women if he would adopt their religion and stop his preaching.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r8.anchor: كانوا مع شدة الأذى له صلى الله عليه وسلم يبذلون له الرغائب من الأموال , والتمليك والتزويج لأعظم نسائهم

BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r9.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r9.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r9.claim: The indefinite either-or prohibition forbids each of the two categories individually, since they stand at the same rank of avoidance.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p275/r9.anchor: والنهي عن الأحد المبهم نهي عن كل منهما

DURR-FULL:v8p377/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p377/r4.speaker: قتادة
DURR-FULL:v8p377/r4.claim: Qatadah says the command not to obey a sinner or ingrate was revealed concerning Abu Jahl.
DURR-FULL:v8p377/r4.anchor: عن قتادة في قوله: {ولا تطع منهم آثما أو كفورا} قال: حدثنا أنها نزلت في عدو الله أبي جهل

DURR-FULL:v8p377/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p377/r5.speaker: قتادة
DURR-FULL:v8p377/r5.claim: Qatadah transmits that Abu Jahl threatened to trample Muhammad’s neck if he saw him praying in Mecca after prayer was prescribed; the verse followed.
DURR-FULL:v8p377/r5.anchor: عن قتادة رضي الله عنه أنه بلغه أن أبا جهل قال: لما فرضت على النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم الصلاة وهو يومئذ بمكة

DURR-FULL:v8p377/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p377/r6.speaker: ابن جريج
DURR-FULL:v8p377/r6.claim: Ibn Jurayj says Abu Jahl made the same threat to trample Muhammad’s neck, and God forbade obeying him.
DURR-FULL:v8p377/r6.anchor: عن ابن جريج رضي الله عنه في قوله: {آثما أو كفورا}

DURR-FULL:v8p377/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p377/r7.speaker: ابن جريج
DURR-FULL:v8p377/r7.claim: Ibn Jurayj glosses “a heavy day” as difficult and severe.
DURR-FULL:v8p377/r7.anchor: وفي قوله: {يوما ثقيلا} قال: عسرا شديدا

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p404/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p404/r1.speaker: قيل
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p404/r1.claim: An anonymous report says Utba offered marriage to induce the Prophet to stop preaching, while the wealthy al-Walid offered enough money; al-Walid is linked to 74:12.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p404/r1.anchor: قيل عرض عتبة على النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أن يرجع عن دعوة الناس إلى الإسلام

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p404/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p404/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p404/r2.claim: Mentioning these two descriptions implicitly censures the men and alludes to their offers and stories.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p404/r2.anchor: فيكون في إيثار هذين الوصفين بالذكر إدماج لذمهما وتلميح لقصتهما

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p404/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p404/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p404/r3.claim: Aw coordinates one member of alternatives in a statement or command; context and syntax make it convey choice, permission, division, doubt, or induced doubt, including with an implied أن.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p404/r3.anchor: وأياما كان فحرف { أو } لم يعد أصل معناه من عطف تشريك أحد شيئين أو أشياء

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p404/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p404/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p404/r4.claim: The prohibition names either of the two types, and by implication forbids obeying both, since doing so necessarily includes obeying one.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p404/r4.anchor: فمعنى الآية نهي عن طاعة أحد هذين الموصوفين ويعلم أن طاعة كليهما منهي عنها

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p404/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p404/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p404/r5.claim: Minhum is a circumstantial phrase attached to athiman: its adjective was placed before the noun and thereby functions as a circumstantial adjunct.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p404/r5.anchor: وموقع { منهم } موقع الحال من { آثما } فإنه صفة { آثما } فلما قدمت الصفة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p404/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p404/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p404/r6.claim: Min is partitive, and its pronoun refers to the polytheists, understood from the preaching context or the implied opponents in the preceding passage.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p404/r6.anchor: و ( من ) للتبعيض . والضمير المجرور بها عائد للمشركين ، ولم يتقدم لهم ذكر

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p404/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p404/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p404/r7.claim: The practical sense is that the Prophet must obey none of the polytheists.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p404/r7.anchor: ويؤول المعنى : ولا تطع أحدا من المشركين

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p408/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p408/r1.speaker: بعض المفسرين
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p408/r1.claim: Some commentators say the whole surah is Meccan.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p408/r1.anchor: قال بعض المفسرين هي مكية كلها

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p408/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p408/r2.speaker: مجاهد، قتادة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p408/r2.claim: Al-Naqqash and al-Tha'labi report from Mujahid and Qatada that the surah is Medinan.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p408/r2.anchor: وحكى النقاش والثعلبي عن مجاهد وقتادة أنها مدنية

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p408/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p408/r3.speaker: الحسن، عكرمة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p408/r3.claim: Hasan and Ikrima say the verse prohibiting obedience to a sinner or ingrate is Meccan while the rest is Medinan; it was revealed over Ali's successive meals for a needy person, orphan, and prisoner.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p408/r3.anchor: وقال الحسن وعكرمة: منها آية مكية وهي قوله تعالى: ولا تطع منهم آثما أو كفورا

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p408/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p408/r4.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p408/r4.claim: Another view says the verse followed Ibn al-Dahdah's act of feeding; the author leaves the matter to God.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p408/r4.anchor: وقيل نزلت في صنيع ابن الدحداح والله أعلم

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r1.claim: Ibn al-Jawzi says the explanation of the command to be patient was already given at 52:48 and 68:48.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r1.anchor: وقد سبق بيانه في مواضع الطور 48 والقلم 48

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r2.speaker: المفسرون
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r2.claim: Some commentators call this verse abrogated by the sword verse; Ibn al-Jawzi says that claim is unsound.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r2.anchor: والمفسرون يقولون هذا منسوخ بآية السيف ولا يصح

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r3.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r3.claim: The people from whom the Prophet must not obey are the Meccan polytheists.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r3.anchor: ولا تطع منهم أي من مشركي أهل مكة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r4.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r4.claim: The conjunction aw can mean wāw, as it does in 6:146.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r4.anchor: أو بمعنى الواو كقوله تعالى أو الحوايا الأنعام 146

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r5.speaker: المفسرون
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r5.claim: One view identifies both the sinful person and the ungrateful person as Abu Jahl.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r6.speaker: المفسرون
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r6.claim: A second view identifies the sinful person as Utba ibn Rabiʿa and the ungrateful person as al-Walid ibn al-Mughira.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r6.anchor: الثاني أن الآثم عتبة بن ربيعة والكفور الوليد بن المغيرة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r7.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r7.speaker: المفسرون
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r7.claim: A third view reverses the identifications: al-Walid is the sinful person and Utba the ungrateful one.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r8.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r8.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r8.claim: Utba and al-Walid told the Prophet to abandon his mission and promised to satisfy him with money and marriage.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p440#3/r8.anchor: وذلك أنهما قالا له ارجع عن هذا الأمر ونحن نرضيك بالمال والتزويج

JISHUMI:v10p7199/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7199/r1.speaker: القاضي
JISHUMI:v10p7199/r1.claim: The qāḍī says Sūrat al-Insān is Meccan, though this is disputed; most say it is entirely Meccan, while others say the whole sūra is Medinan.
JISHUMI:v10p7199/r1.anchor: قال القاضي: وهي مكية على اختلاف فيه، وقيل: كلها مكية

JISHUMI:v10p7199/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7199/r2.speaker: مجاهد، وقتادة
JISHUMI:v10p7199/r2.claim: Mujāhid and Qatādah are cited for the view that the whole sūra is Medinan.
JISHUMI:v10p7199/r2.anchor: وقيل: كلها مدنية، عن مجاهد، وقتادة

JISHUMI:v10p7199/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7199/r3.speaker: الحسن وعكرمة
JISHUMI:v10p7199/r3.claim: Al-Ḥasan and ʿIkrimah say the verse prohibiting obedience to a sinner or disbeliever is Meccan and the rest of the sūra is Medinan.
JISHUMI:v10p7199/r3.anchor: وهي قوله: (ولا تطع منهم آثما أو كفورا) والباقي مدنية، عن الحسن وعكرمة

JISHUMI:v10p7199/r5.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7199/r5.speaker: أبي بن كعب، النبي
JISHUMI:v10p7199/r5.claim: Ubayy ibn Kaʿb transmits from the Prophet that whoever recites Sūrat Hal Atā will receive Paradise and silk as a reward from God.
JISHUMI:v10p7199/r5.anchor: وعن أبي بن كعب، عن النبي - صلى الله عليه وسلم -: من قرأ سورة (هل أتى)

JISHUMI:v10p7199/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7199/r6.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7199/r6.claim: Sūrat al-Insān begins by repeating the proof from human creation that closed Sūrat al-Qiyāmah, which had ended by affirming resurrection.
JISHUMI:v10p7199/r6.anchor: ولما ختم سورة (لا أقسم) بصحة البعث، وما دل عليه من خلق الإنسان من نطفة، ابتدأ هذه السورة بمثل ذلك

MUQATIL:76:23-24/r1.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:76:23-24/r1.speaker: author
MUQATIL:76:23-24/r1.claim: Muqatil returns to the earlier command that Muhammad be patient with God's judgment.
MUQATIL:76:23-24/r1.anchor: ثم رجع إلى قوله عز وجل الأول: { إنا نحن نزلنا عليك القرآن تنزيلا فاصبر لحكم ربك

MUQATIL:76:23-24/r2.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:76:23-24/r2.speaker: author
MUQATIL:76:23-24/r2.claim: Those urging Muhammad to disobey are the unbelievers who love worldly life and concern themselves only with possessions and material goods.
MUQATIL:76:23-24/r2.anchor: { إن هؤلاء } الذين يأمرونك بالكفر { يحبون العاجلة } يعني الدنيا، لا يهمهم شىء إلا أمر الدنيا الذهب والفضة

NASAFI-FULL:v4p305#4/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p305#4/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p305#4/r1.claim: Be patient in conveying the message, bearing harm, and waiting for victory over the Meccan enemies.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p305#4/r1.anchor: عليك بتبليغ الرسالة واحتمال الأذية وتأخير نصرتك على أعدائك من أهل مكة

NASAFI-FULL:v4p305#4/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p305#4/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p305#4/r2.claim: Do not obey unbelievers out of frustration over delayed victory when they call you to sin or disbelief; obeying a request that is neither is not forbidden.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p305#4/r2.anchor: من الكفرة للضجر من تأخير الظفر ﴿ إثما ﴾ راكبا لما هو آثم

NASAFI-FULL:v4p305#4/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p305#4/r3.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p305#4/r3.claim: An “آثم” commits sin and invites the Prophet to it; a “كفور” commits disbelief and invites him to it.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p305#4/r3.anchor: راكبا لما هو آثم داعيا لكل اليه ﴿ أو كفورا ﴾ فاعلا لما هو كفر

NASAFI-FULL:v4p305#4/r4.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p305#4/r4.speaker: قيل
NASAFI-FULL:v4p305#4/r4.claim: One reported identification calls the sinner ʿUtbah and the disbeliever al-Walid, respectively.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p305#4/r4.anchor: وقيل الآثم عتبة لانه كان ركابا المآثم والفسوق والكفور الوليد لأنه كان غالبا في الكفر والجحود

NASAFI-FULL:v4p305#4/r5.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p305#4/r5.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p305#4/r5.claim: The apparent meaning is any sinner or disbeliever; “أو” forbids obeying either one, individually or together, whereas “و” might only forbid obeying both jointly.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p305#4/r5.anchor: والظاهر أن المراد كل آثم وكافر أي لا تطع أحدهما وإذا نهى عن طاعة أحدهما لا بعينه فقد نهى عن طاعتهما معا ومتفرقا

NASAFI-FULL:v4p305#4/r6.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p305#4/r6.speaker: قيل
NASAFI-FULL:v4p305#4/r6.claim: An alternative takes “أو” in the sense of “ولا”, so the instruction means do not obey a sinner or a disbeliever.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p305#4/r6.anchor: وقيل أو بمعنى ولا أي ولا تطع آثما ولا كفورا

QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r4.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r4.claim: Qurtubi glosses patience with God’s decree.
QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r4.anchor: قوله تعالى: { فاصبر لحكم ربك } أي لقضاء ربك

QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r5.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r5.claim: Al-Dahhak transmits Ibn Abbas’s view: endure polytheist abuse as decreed; this was later abrogated by the fighting verse.
QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r5.anchor: وروى الضحاك عن ابن عباس قال: اصبر على أذى المشركين هكذا قضيت

QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r6.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r6.claim: Another view says to be patient in the acts of obedience God imposed.
QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r6.anchor: وقيل: أي اصبر لما حكم به عليك من الطاعات

QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r7.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r7.claim: A further view says to await God’s promised victory without haste, since it will certainly come.
QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r7.anchor: أو انتظر حكم الله إذا وعدك أنه ينصرك عليهم

QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r8.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r8.claim: Athim means a sinner and kafūr an unbeliever.
QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r8.anchor: آثما } أي ذا إثم { أو كفورا } أي لا تطع الكفار

QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r9.speaker: قتادة
QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r9.claim: Maʿmar transmits Qatada’s report that Abu Jahl threatened to trample Muhammad’s neck if he saw him praying; the verse was revealed in response.
QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r9.anchor: عن قتادة قال: قال أبو جهل: إن رأيت محمدا يصلي لأطأن على عنقه

QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r10.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r10.claim: Another occasion account concerns ʿUtba and al-Walid, who offered wealth and marriage in exchange for abandoning prophethood.
QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r10.anchor: نزلت في عتبة بن ربيعة والوليد بن المغيرة

QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r11.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r11.speaker: مقاتل
QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r11.claim: Muqatil specifies that ʿUtba offered his daughter without dowry if Muhammad withdrew, while al-Walid promised money if wealth was his motive.
QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r11.anchor: قال مقاتل: الذي عرض التزويج عتبة بن ربيعة قال: إن بناتي من أجمل نساء قريش

QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r12.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r12.speaker: الزجاج
QURTUBI-FULL:76:23-24/r12.claim: Al-Zajjaj says aw is more emphatic than waw because each of the sinner and unbeliever is individually someone not to obey.
